messages:
Sam P: hey folks — trying to finish setup for day 2 but hit a few blocks. Okta passkey enrollment keeps erroring with 'device not supported', and my Google Drive shows empty after I accepted the invite. Anyone seen this before?
Lisa (People Ops): welcome!! tagging IT — @Ani (IT) can you triage? also ping me if we need to re-send onboarding docs. :wave:
Ani (IT): hey @Sam P — sorry about that. quick q: are you on personal mac or a company-provided mac? and which OS version?
Sam P: company MacBook Pro, macOS 13.5 — just finished setup from the provisioning email.
Ani (IT): thanks. two things to check quickly: 1) in Okta -> Security Devices, remove any stale passkeys then try re-enroll. 2) for Drive, can you confirm you accepted the invite with your corporate email, not a personal alias?
Sam P: ok doing step 1 now. for Drive i clicked the invite link from people-ops email which showed my work email. nothing in Drive web UI except an empty 'Shared with me'.
Ani (IT): hmm, sometimes Drive group permissions take a minute to propagate. i'll check the directory sync. Can you run:
```
dscl . -read /Users/$(whoami) GeneratedUID
```
and paste the short UID output? helps me correlate AD vs Google account.
Sam P: uid is `A1B2C3D4-E5F6-7890-ABCD-EF1234567890`
Ani (IT): ty. I'm seeing your account in our Okta org but the passkey enrollment failed with a platform mismatch from the device keychain. Two options: 1) enroll using a security key (Yubikey) or 2) remove the existing keychain entry and re-run. To remove run:
```
security delete-keychain login.keychain-db
```
(only if you know you created it during setup). If unsure, i'll remote into your machine for 5 mins.
Sam P: would prefer remote — don't want to nuke something accidentally.
Ani (IT): ok scheduling a quick remote. sending invite now. IT-Bot: remote session scheduled with Ani at 14:10 PST.
IT-Bot: session link: https://remote.example.com/session/1933456789-ani
Dev-Bot: 1Password invite re-sent to sam.p@redwood.ai (automated).
Sam P: got the remote link and the 1Password invite arrived. thanks!
Michael G: hey @Sam P, quick heads-up — once Drive is working can you confirm access to repo docs in the shared drive folder `eng/onboarding`? i added a couple of repo keys you might need.
Sam P: will check after the remote. thanks everyone.
Ani (IT): remote done — passkey issue was leftover personal passkey entries. cleaned up and re-enrolled, tested Okta MFA pass. Also fixed Google group membership (sync lag). you should now see `Shared with me` + the `Redwood > Eng` folder. can you confirm?
Sam P: confirmed! Drive shows eng/onboarding and I can open 1Password. Okta login with passkey succeeded. :tada:
Lisa (People Ops): awesome — welcome aboard again! if you want a buddy or a quick walkthrough of docs let me know.
Sam P: appreciate it — thanks @Ani and team.
Ani (IT): np. leaving a short checklist in the #it-setup channel so others can search this. adding a note: if macOS Keychain weirdness, prefer remote rather than running delete commands alone.
Dev-Bot: Incident note created: IT-1933456789 - new hire passkey + google sync (closed).
